item.title: Clare Social Enterprise Conference To Celebrate Impact And Empower Local Changemakers
item.description: Clare Local Development Company (CLDC) will host the Clare Social Enterprise Conference 2025 on Wednesday, 10th December at The Inn at Dromoland. It will bring together social enterprises, community leaders and local changemakers from across the county. The event will celebrate the growing impact of Clare’s social enterprises while offering practical learning, networking opportunities. item.title: Pedestrian Hospitalised After Being Hit By Vehicle In Ennis
item.description: A man has been taken to hospital after being struck by a vehicle in Ennis this afternoon. It’s understood a van collided with the individual on Lower Abbey Street shortly after 1pm. Units from An Garda Síochána, Clare County Fire and Rescue Service and the National Ambulance Service have attended the scene. item.title: Planning Permission Refused For Controversial West Clare Wind Farm
item.description: Concerns for the protected raptor, the Hen Harrier and the protected butterfly, Marsh Fritillary have helped put paid to contentious plans for a five turbine 492 ft high wind-farm close to the home of the Willie Clancy Summer School, Miltown Malbay in west Clare. item.title: Water Outages In Shannon Following Burst Main
item.description: Homes and businesses in Shannon are without water this evening following a burst to a water main. item.title: Status Red Storm Warning Issued Off Clare’s Coast
item.description: A Status Red storm warning comes into effect off Clare’s coast tomorrow. Met Éireann is warning that winds will occassionally reach violent storm force 11 from Loop Head to Malin Head between 12pm and 11:30pm on Tuesday.
